source_title: Introducing an EdTech and AI product safety certification scheme
title_zh: 推出教育科技與 AI 產品安全認證制度
original_excerpt: This consultation sets out DfE’s proposal to establish a product certification scheme to assure the safety of EdTech used in schools and other education settings in England. … Subject to the outcome of this consultation, a minimum of 18 months would be needed to establish the product certification scheme, before products could be certified, followed by a transition period to allow adoption by suppliers and education settings. … Certification would not make a wider assessment of a product’s overall quality or educational effectiveness. The exception to this is where effectiveness is directly relevant to safety, that is, the product’s lack of efficacy could put children at risk of harm. … Student-facing generative AI products would be assessed against the following eight standards from the generative AI: product safety standards: … Under these proposals, a product certification scheme is technically non-mandatory. While a clear expectation would be included within statutory guidance, DfE does not have specific powers to require education settings to use certified EdTech products or to require EdTech suppliers to obtain safety certification for their products.
claim_text: 來源機構：英國教育部（Department for Education）；資料標題：Introducing an EdTech and AI product safety certification scheme；來源刊登日：2026-11-10。內容：英國教育部就一項產品認證制度公開諮詢，目的在確保英格蘭學校與其他教育場所使用的教育科技與 AI 產品安全；諮詢自 2026 年 11 月 10 日起，至 2027 年 2 月 4 日截止，諮詢結果與英國教育部的回應預定 2027 年春季公布。文件表示，視諮詢結果，建立認證制度至少需 18 個月，之後才能認證產品，並另有讓業者與教育場所採用的過渡期；認證只評估安全，不另評估產品整體品質或教學成效，唯成效不足會使兒童受害時除外。擬納入的產品分四類：過濾產品、對兒童資料進行高風險處理的教育科技、面向學生的生成式 AI 工具、面向學生的個人化學習工具；風險較低的產品不納入；教師、學院或學校自建、只在該教育場所使用的「代理」、自訂 AI 工具或封裝工具擬免認證。面向學生的生成式 AI 產品擬依〈生成式 AI：產品安全標準〉中的八項標準評估：過濾、監控與通報、設計與測試、治理、認知發展、情緒與社會發展、心理健康、操弄。認證擬由取得英國認證機構（UKAS）認可的符合性評鑑機構辦理，英國教育部擬公開登錄通過認證的產品，供教育場所選用。文件寫明在此提案下，認證制度在技術上並非法定義務，英國教育部目前沒有要求學校使用或業者取得認證的特定權限，並就未來是否需要立法徵詢意見。說明：本文件為公開諮詢，內容尚未定案，最終制度以英國教育部日後公布者為準。（AI 輔助整理，未經真人逐則審稿；請參閱原文。）

source_title: Orientaciones para la integración de la inteligencia artificial en los centros educativos
title_zh: 學校整合人工智慧的指引
source_organization: 西班牙國家教育科技與師資培育研究所（INTEF）
original_excerpt: Este documento pretende contribuir al proceso de integración de la IA en los centros educativos a partir de tres ejes complementarios: … Alfabetización: se refiere al desarrollo de conocimientos, capacidades y actitudes que permiten comprender, utilizar y valorar críticamente la IA. … Es recomendable que cada centro educativo elabore un plan de integración de la IA que establezca principios comunes, responsabilidades, límites de uso, actuaciones formativas, medidas de seguimiento e indicadores de evaluación. Este plan deberá partir de un diagnóstico inicial y realista del contexto del centro, de forma que las actuaciones propuestas sean viables y puedan revisarse periódicamente. … Los siguientes capítulos tienen carácter orientativo y deben asumirse como recomendaciones, siempre sujetas a la regulación establecida por la Administración educativa competente. … Se recomienda constituir un grupo de trabajo, de coordinación o equipo impulsor de la IA dentro del propio centro.
claim_text: 來源機構：西班牙國家教育科技與師資培育研究所（INTEF）；資料標題：Orientaciones para la integración de la inteligencia artificial en los centros educativos；來源刊登日：2026-11-10。內容：西班牙國家教育科技與師資培育研究所（INTEF）發布 61 頁的學校整合 AI 指引（版權頁印 2026 年 11 月），以規範、素養、協作三軸支持學校規劃納入 AI；素養指發展能理解、使用並批判評價 AI 的知識、能力與態度。指引表示，宜由各校訂定 AI 整合計畫，列出共同原則、責任、使用限制、培訓行動、追蹤措施與評估指標，並以學校現況的初步診斷為起點、定期檢討。指引列出十項基本原則，包括 AI 服務於人與教育目的、人類監督與教師的專業責任、倫理與負責任使用、預防認知惰性並發展批判思考、資料保護與隱私安全、公平與包容、透明與可追溯、治理與問責等。組織方面，指引提出在校內成立 AI 工作或協調小組，並依七個階段推進：成立小組、分析現況、檢視規範、設定目標、設計行動方針、逐步實施、追蹤評估與修訂。行動方針有六項：推動教師培訓、監督 AI 工具的教育用途、製作與分享課堂方案、把 AI 納入行政與管理流程、向家庭說明並合作、製作與推廣負責任使用指南；附錄另有一所學校 AI 整合計畫的參考範例。說明：指引寫明各章屬參考性質，應視為建議，並一律遵循主管教育行政機關的規定。（AI 輔助整理，未經真人逐則審稿；請參閱原文。）

source_title: Synergizing Mind and Machine: Unlocking the Potential of Generative AI With Metacognitive Scaffolding to Optimize Upper Elementary Student Learning
title_zh: 心智與機器協同：以後設認知鷹架發揮生成式 AI 潛力，優化小學高年級學生學習
original_excerpt: This quasi-experimental, explanatory sequential mixed-methods study evaluated metacognitive scaffolding (MS) embedded in a GAI-supported learning environment. … The study was conducted at a public elementary school in coastal southern China with 101 Grade 5–6 students (ages 10–12) enrolled in a 13-week extracurricular AI course. … Results show that, after adjustment for baseline AI literacy and metacognitive capacity, MS-GAI students demonstrated higher AI knowledge and ethics than students in both comparison conditions. No condition effect meeting the familywise-adjusted criterion was found for AI skills or motivation. Students in the unscaffolded GAI condition also reported less positive and more negative attitudes toward AI than those in the other conditions. … Exploratory round-level comparisons indicated that MS-GAI was associated with more reflective and synergistic interactions in the later instructional phases. … The matched quasi-experimental intervention involved 101 students from a single public school in southern coastal China, so the results should be treated as context-specific rather than population-level or randomized causal estimates.
claim_text: 來源機構：Computers & Education（Elsevier）；資料標題：Synergizing Mind and Machine: Unlocking the Potential of Generative AI With Metacognitive Scaffolding to Optimize Upper Elementary Student Learning；來源刊登日：2026-11-10。樣本：作者報告研究在中國華南沿海一所公立小學進行，對象為參加 13 週課外 AI 課程的 101 名 5–6 年級學生（10–12 歲）；學生依校方學業成績紀錄配對後分為三組：有後設認知鷹架的生成式 AI 組 35 人、無鷹架的生成式 AI 組 33 人、傳統搜尋引擎組 33 人。設計：作者稱採準實驗、解釋性序列混合方法設計。三組內容、順序與授課時數相同，由同一位 AI 教育專家授課，差異只在探究工具（生成式 AI 組用 iFlytek Spark，搜尋引擎組用百度）與是否提供鷹架；鷹架是學習單上的四個提示，依序對應設定目標、策略規劃、自我監控與自我評估。AI 素養以知識、技能、倫理、正向態度、負向態度與學習動機六項於課程前後施測，並以前測與後設認知能力為共變量比較三組；另錄下兩個生成式 AI 組學生與 AI 的 779 回合互動，以紮根理論編碼，並以學習單與 7 場焦點團體訪談分析鷹架組 35 名學生如何使用提示。作者所述發現：作者報告，調整基線 AI 素養與後設認知能力後，鷹架組的 AI 知識與倫理分數高於另兩組，AI 技能與學習動機的組別差異未達多重比較校正後的標準；無鷹架的生成式 AI 組對 AI 的態度較不正向、較多負向。互動分析歸納出即興、戰術、反思、協同四種互動模式，作者稱屬探索性的回合層級比較顯示，鷹架組在後期教學階段有較多反思與協同互動。限制：作者自述樣本僅來自中國華南沿海一所公立學校，結果應視為特定情境，而非母群層級或隨機分派的因果估計；互動模式架構需外部驗證；整合式鷹架無法區分個別提示的作用；三組由同一位教師授課；質性資料只來自鷹架組；成果只在課程結束後立即測量。說明：所據為 Journal Pre-proof 版本，正式版內容可能變動。（AI 輔助整理，未經真人逐則審稿；請參閱原文。）

title_zh: 在論說文寫作教學中應用生成式人工智慧：越南中學教師調查結果
original_excerpt: This study reports survey findings on Vietnamese secondary teachers’ use, perceptions and professional learning needs regarding Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) in argumentative writing instruction (Years 6–9). Based on responses from 515 teachers, the analysis examines GenAI applications across the writing cycle, perceived impacts on student learning, barriers to adoption and areas for support. Results show widespread awareness of GenAI and clear preferences for tools such as ChatGPT, which teachers mainly use for planning and modelling tasks rather than for feedback or assessment. … Most teachers view GenAI as helpful for improving students’ ability to plan and develop arguments, but challenges include time constraints, limited training and concerns about tool quality and academic integrity. Professional learning needs are significant, especially among mid- and senior-career teachers and vary by school context. … To address the gap mentioned, the present study employs a survey design to explore Vietnamese teachers’ perspectives on GenAI in argumentative writing instruction. Given the limited empirical research on GenAI use in secondary writing classrooms, the study is exploratory in nature, with the aim of documenting teachers’ reported practices and perceptions rather than testing predefined hypotheses. … Valid responses were received from 515 teachers, who were recruited using a convenience sampling strategy through professional networks, school clusters and regional training lists. Because the survey link was disseminated through open, cascading channels rather than a fixed distribution list, the total number of teachers who received the invitation could not be determined, and a conventional response rate could not be calculated. … Several limitations should be acknowledged. Firstly, the study is based on teachers’ self-reported practices and perceptions, which may not reflect what happens in actual classroom settings. Relatedly, although a large majority of teachers reported frequently verifying GenAI-generated content, the survey instrument measured only the frequency of verification and did not capture how teachers verified outputs – for example, whether they cross-checked against authoritative sources, consulted colleagues, or simply re-read the content for plausibility – which is an important distinction for judging the quality, rather than merely the frequency, of GenAI use. In addition, participants were recruited through voluntary, convenience-based sampling with no defined sampling frame, meaning that a response rate could not be calculated and the sample may be somewhat skewed towards teachers who already have an interest in GenAI. As a cross-sectional study conducted near the end of the school year, the findings offer a snapshot of teachers’ experiences at a particular point in time and cannot capture how these practices and perceptions may change.

title_zh: 邁向 K–12 學校實務中經校準的 AI 準備度：AI 相關知識警覺能力與治理明確度的角色
original_excerpt: This two-phase study examined calibrated AI readiness, defined as self-reported readiness to verify AI outputs, recognize ethical boundaries, and retain responsibility for AI-assisted professional decisions. … Participants were practicing school psychologists and related school-based professionals, including supervisors, school counselors, teachers and special education professionals working in K-12 settings. … In Phase 1, AI-related epistemic vigilance capacity and governance clarity were positively associated with self-reported calibrated AI readiness, whereas autonomous regulatory motivation was not a significant direct predictor. … Phase 2 showed descriptive increases in self-reported readiness following a one-month pilot training program, while scenario-based assessments provided separate evidence of applied responsible AI reasoning. However, self-reported changes and scenario-based reasoning were not significantly associated. … Because Phase 1 was cross-sectional and Phase 2 lacked a comparison group, the results do not establish causal effects.

source_title: 中小學使用「生成式人工智慧」注意事項2.1（教師、行政人員及家長版）
original_excerpt: 為了幫助中小學教師、行政人員及家長提升「生成式人工智慧」（Generative AI，簡稱GenAI）工具使用素養，理解使用的倫理原則，並能在教育情境中落實安全、合規與負責任的使用方式，以善用相關技術並避免造成誤用或濫用，提供以下注意事項作為使用參考。 … 學校亦需建立明確的使用規範，協助學生理解作業可否使用生成式工具、應如何標註，以及哪些行為可能構成抄襲、代寫或學術不端，以維護學術誠信。 … 考量科技變動快速，本注意事項僅列出本部建置或具公益性之平臺；若需使用其他商用版的「生成式人工智慧」工具，應經由學校評估資安風險，並在師長指導下審慎使用。
